purpose: Replace the invalid projected-type-3-only comparison by the strongest accuracy-qualified geometry-aware baseline before rerunning the complete 800-orientation, five-hierarchy workload.

historical_boundary.reason_not_reused: The old protocol incorrectly declared type-2 ineligible because it did not recognize that every orientation is an affine rotation of the same 20^3 Cartesian lattice.
seen_before_this_freeze: orientation-1 local RTX 2070 SUPER type-2 accuracy probes
orientation-1 local RTX 2070 SUPER linear FFT interpolation probes through pad 24
the old projected type-3 RTX 3090 result, retained only as historical context
not_seen_before_this_freeze: any RTX 3090 timing screen under this protocol
any independent 30-sample confirmation under this protocol
type-2 or affine-grid FFT timings for public orientations 2 through 800
any five-hierarchy result produced by the strongest baseline selected here

affine_lattice_contract.orientation_invariance: shape, active integer indices, and Gram matrix must match orientation 1; the fitted basis map must be a proper rotation
affine_lattice_contract.coefficient_contract: scatter N,Mx,My,Mz into four zero-filled 20^3 arrays
affine_lattice_contract.type2_identity: F(q)=exp(-i q dot center) sum_m c[m] exp(-i wrap(B^T q) dot m), with centered modeord=0 indices
affine_lattice_contract.cost_assignment: per-orientation basis recovery/certification, B^Tq transform, wrapping, coefficient zero-fill/scatter, all H2D transfers, setpts, execute, and phase correction are timed

accuracy_qualification.direct_target_rule: unique evenly spaced flattened detector indices including both endpoints

affine_type2.selection_rule: choose the largest eps passing both frozen direct gates; do not use timing

projected_type3_control.selection_rule: choose the largest eps passing both frozen direct gates; do not use timing
projected_type3_control.role: eligible nonuniform control, not the sole comparator

dense_periodic_fft.interpolation: periodic trilinear interpolation of a zero-padded batched 3-D FFT
dense_periodic_fft.qualification_rule: retain every pad factor passing both frozen direct gates and the remote memory cap; no timing may enter this step
dense_periodic_fft.screen_selection_rule: among accuracy-qualified pads, select the lowest median end-to-end per-orientation time on the frozen RTX 3090 screen

timing_screen.candidate_order: declared ascending pad order followed by descending pad order allocation warm-up; only the seven forward timed samples enter each median
timing_screen.included_costs: basis/target transform, wrap, scatter, H2D, interpolation-map preparation, FFT, interpolation, phase correction, and synchronization

independent_confirmation.machine: same POSTECH NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090 process after the screen
independent_confirmation.pairing: each baseline is compared with ACFO in a separate deterministic ABBA sequence
independent_confirmation.strongest_baseline_rule: before loading orientation 2, select the confirmed baseline with the smallest median inclusive time among accuracy-qualified arms
independent_confirmation.no_posthoc_hardware_transfer: RTX 2070 rankings cannot select the RTX 3090 baseline

full_ensemble.paired_order: ACFO then selected baseline for odd orientations; selected baseline then ACFO for even orientations
full_ensemble.five_hierarchy_reducer: the exact common dilute/packed reducer is timed separately and applied to both arms
full_ensemble.primary_speed_ratio: selected strongest baseline total Fourier time divided by ACFO total Fourier time at N_ori=800
full_ensemble.unfavorable_result_policy: preserve and report; never replace the selected baseline after orientation 2 has been loaded
